messages.author: 07446e536e285021
messages.subject: Capture Input data from forms
parts:
Dear colleagues,
I wrote a form to capture 2 different variables, one would be
alphanumeric (the method of analysis, 3 choices) and the second a
numeric variable (a pre-defined threshold value).
The form in my html reads:

<form name="form" method="POST" action="#">
<b>Choose the Method:</b><br />
<select name="menu">
<option value="LOGIT" id="logit">LOGISTIC REGRESSION</option>
<option value="MULTIREG" id="mregression">MULTIPLE REGRESSION</
option>
<option value="RF" id="rf">RANDOM FOREST</option>
</select><br /><br />

<label>Enter the Threshold:</label>
<input type="text" name=Threshold id=Threshold value="10"></input>
<input type="submit" onClick="RePlot()" value="Click here"></
input>
</form><br />


I want to capture the 2 input values (METHOD AND THRESHOLD) in R with
the function RePlot():

function RePlot(){
<%
brew('/var/www/brew/replot.rhtml')
%>
}

According to the suggestions that I found in the list, this is my
replot.rhtml:

<%
in_form <- readLines(stdin(),n=1, ok=TRUE);
if (pushBackLength(stdin()) > 0) {
incomplete_ln <- unlist(scan(what='list',sep="\n",quiet=TRUE));
lns <- c(in_form,incomplete_ln);
#lns1 <-???????
l#ns2 <-???????
}

%>
When I see the lns object, I see that it contains the whole input data
in the form but as a single concatenated string, for example :
"menu=LOGIT&Threshold=10"

However I would like to capture the results LOGIT and 10 as two
different variables (lns1 and lns2). Is there any form to separate
both input data from the stdin() function?? (I tried with grep but it
does not work when I run it in Rapache).

Thanks in advance

Luis

messages.author: 25a4f5811cd7d59e
messages.subject: Re: Capture Input data from forms
parts:
That code you referenced is for custom form processing. If you just
want to get at the form elements individually, then just access the
POST variable directly. Scope out section 5 of the manual here:

http://rapache.net/manual.html#rapache_Functions

Best,

Jeff
